# 08 Carry

Full definition: [TAXONOMY.md](../../TAXONOMY.md), section 3.

**What belongs here.** A specific element keeps its identity and leads the viewer from A into B.

**Test.** Is there an element the eye follows from A into B that stays the same thing throughout?

**Not here.** If the element changes identity it is 07 Morph. A camera move with no leading element is 05 Motion. A big element that only blocks the view is 04 Cover.

**Build.** Needs both scenes: one shared element animates across the sequence boundary, or A and B are one composition.

## Subfamilies

| Folder | What goes in it | Examples |
|---|---|---|
| [Object-Led](object-led/) | An object travels across and becomes part of B's layout. | ball rolls into the next scene |
| [Line-Led](line-led/) | A drawn line or path becomes B's structure. | line becomes a chart axis, path becomes a route |
| [Type-Led](type-led/) | A word or title stays while the scene rebuilds around it. | headline stays as the background changes |
| [Portal](portal/) | The camera moves into an element that contains B. | zoom into a screen, a window, a letter's counter |

## Transitions in this family

| Transition | Subfamily | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [Dot Led](object-led/dot-led/) | Object-Led | A dot bounces across the old scene and lands, then the new scene grows out of it. |
| [Line Led](line-led/line-led/) | Line-Led | A line draws across the frame, then opens into a band that becomes the new scene as its edges travel out of frame. |
| [Type Led](type-led/type-led/) | Type-Led | A word lands on the old scene and stays put while the scene changes behind it, then flies away. |
| [Portal Zoom](portal/portal-zoom/) | Portal | A round window opens in the old scene showing the new one, and the camera flies into it. |
